title: Kodak Charmera Review
summary: A mini review of the Kodak Charmera
content:
Over a year ago I bought a Kodak Charmera keyring mini camera; it's a tiny little camera that takes photos at 1440x1080 and I was lucky enough to get the best design. It's taken me until now to actually try it out at Alice Holt forest today — we went because they have Gruffalo sculptures and the Knightlings are obsessed.

The photos are about as good as I expected which is not good at all but it is a fun camera to use. I think I'll stick with the Camp Snap.

A mouse took a stroll through the deep dark wood,
The mouse took photos with his Kodak Charmera and they were not good.
